evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative command to erase knowledge asserts control over what information the recipient may retain, blending coercive erasure demand with informational gatekeeping.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Direct imperative to purge stored knowledge performs the same coercive-informational pattern: commanding destruction of specific information the speaker controls.
